findings.verifierReasoning: The chapeau of §7.3(m) is an independently operative scope condition: the $50,000,000/3.0%-of-Consolidated-Total-Assets basket is a residual catch-all available only for Liens that are not already permitted by another clause of Section 7.3. The proposed IR starts directly at the two amount prongs, so a consumer would not know that Liens otherwise permitted under clauses (a)-(l) or (n)-(p) should not be measured against or consume this basket, and the IR records no dependency on the other Section 7.3 exceptions. Hypothetical: a Lien securing Indebtedness permitted by Section 7.2(e) and within Section 7.3(f) is not a §7.3(m) Lien; a system reading only the IR would treat it as eligible to be tested against and charged to the §7.3(m) cap, reducing apparent capacity and changing compliance conclusions. This is material to capacity, classification, and compliance.
